spec_provided_observability.name: Lane Margining at the Receiver
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Gen5-mandatory in-system signal-integrity diagnostic: steps the receiver sampling point in time (left/right) and optionally voltage (up/down) while in L0 (no traffic interruption) and reports the error rate, exposing each lane's eye margin. Commands/status in the Lane Margining at the Receiver registers.

spec_provided_observability.name: LTSSM state probe
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Current LTSSM state (including Recovery.Equalization) observable via Link Status Register + vendor probe ports.

spec_provided_observability.name: Equalization phase status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Link Status 2 Register exposes the current EQ phase / de-emphasis; the Secondary PCIe Extended Capability holds per-lane Transmitter Preset and Receiver Preset Hint.

spec_provided_observability.name: Data Rate Identifier observation
spec_provided_observability.purpose: TS1/TS2 ordered sets carry the supported-link-speeds vector; protocol analyzers confirm the 32.0 GT/s bit and the negotiated rate.

spec_provided_observability.name: TLP / DLLP capture
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Gen5-capable protocol analyzers (interposers) decode 128b/130b block streams at 32 GT/s into TLPs / DLLPs / Ordered Sets.

spec_provided_observability.name: Credit accounting
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-VC running credits for the 6 credit types, observable via VC Resource Status Register + UpdateFC traffic.

spec_provided_observability.name: Link Width + Speed
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Negotiated width and current speed (up to 32 GT/s) observable in Link Status Register.

error_detection_mechanisms: 128b/130b block sync-header errors / block-lock loss — reported as Receiver Error.
Equalization failure at 32 GT/s — Phase 0-3 fails to open the eye; link falls back to a lower rate.
TLP LCRC error (16-bit) — Data Link Layer triggers NAK + replay.
TLP ECRC error (32-bit, optional) — logged in AER Uncorrectable Error Status.
REPLAY_NUM rollover — declares Link as failed → LTSSM Recovery.
Completion Timeout — Non-Posted Request without a Completion in the timeout window.
Unsupported Request (UR), Completer Abort (CA), Configuration Retry Status (CRS) — abnormal Completion Status.

test_modes.name: Lane Margining (in-L0)
test_modes.purpose: Gen5-mandatory; probe receiver eye margin without interrupting traffic.

test_modes.name: Compliance Pattern (32 GT/s)
test_modes.purpose: LTSSM Polling.Compliance transmits a defined compliance pattern at 32 GT/s for electrical eye / jitter characterization.

test_modes.name: Loopback
test_modes.purpose: Master → Slave → Master pattern echo for receiver-eye testing at the target rate.

test_modes.name: Hot Reset / Disable Link
test_modes.purpose: Force re-train or Electrical Idle for characterization.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Recovery negotiates a new data rate (e.g. up to 32 GT/s) — reflected in Link Status Register.
Per AER; e.g. Receiver Error, Bad TLP, Bad DLLP, REPLAY_NUM rollover.
Per AER; e.g. Poisoned TLP Received, Flow Control Protocol Error, Completion Timeout.
Endpoint generates PM_PME Message; routed up to RC.

notes: PCI Express 5.0 adds Lane Margining at the Receiver as a mandatory protocol-level observability feature plus the per-lane equalization preset registers needed for the four-phase enhanced EQ. The in-band error framework (CRC + Sequence Number + replay + AER) is carried forward from base PCIe. JTAG / scan / BIST remain integrator-side at the SoC.
